meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中运行本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local models and manage model library
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run local LLMs in containers and manage model libraries

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 多了一批叫 Ollama 的工具,能查看本地已安装的模型、让某个模型回答问题;若开启管理开关,还能下载、删除模型、查看正在运行的模型和详情。
howto.when: 安装后这些工具常驻;当你要求用 Ollama 或本地模型回答问题、列出模型,或让模型做推理时,Claude 就会调用它们。

say.text: 用 Ollama 告诉我法国的首都。
say.note: Claude 会列出模型,选一个生成回答。

say.text: 列出当前装了哪些 Ollama 模型。
say.note: 调用列表工具,显示模型名、大小等信息。

say.text: 拉取 gemma3:1b 这个模型。
say.note: 需开启管理开关;否则只暴露列表和生成。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains a set of Ollama tools: it can list locally installed models, send a prompt to a chosen model and return the response. If the admin flag is enabled, it can also pull, delete, show, and list running models.
howto.when_en: The tools are always available after installation. Claude uses them whenever you ask to use Ollama or a local model, to list models, or to generate a response from a local model.

say_en.text: Use Ollama to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude lists models, picks one, and generates an answer.
Calls the list tool to show model details.
Requires admin flag; otherwise only list and generate are exposed.
